item.description:
🇫🇷 🚨 FRENCH INSURER ASSURIMO: 954K RECORDS ALLEGEDLY OFFERED FOR SALE

A threat actor on an underground forum claims to be selling a database of about 954,000 records allegedly taken from Assurimo, a French online insurance platform.

The actor claims the dataset includes:
* Customer names, emails, phone numbers and addresses
* Policy numbers, quotes and insurance contract data
* SEPA payment (bank direct debit) information

The claim has not been independently verified.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
If genuine, policy and SEPA banking details paired with contact data would enable convincing insurance-themed phishing and direct-debit fraud against French customers. The actor claims access came through poorly secured backend APIs. Authenticity and freshness remain unconfirmed.

#DDW #DarkWeb #France #Insurance #DataLeak #PII #ThreatIntelligence #CyberSecurity

item.description:
🇲🇽 🚨 MOVIMIENTO ANTORCHISTA MEMBER REGISTRY ALLEGEDLY OFFERED FOR SALE

A threat actor on an underground forum claims to be selling a database of 596,652 Mexican citizens allegedly taken from the internal membership registry of Movimiento Antorchista (Antorcha Revolucionaria), a large Mexican political and social organization.

The actor claims the dataset includes:
* Full names
* CURP and INE voter ID numbers
* Addresses and phone numbers
* Membership status and political hierarchy
* In some cases, medical history and next-of-kin details

The claim has not been independently verified.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
If genuine, CURP and INE numbers are core identifiers for banking and government services in Mexico, making the data directly usable for identity fraud. Political affiliation data also raises the risk of targeted phishing or harassment of members. Authenticity and freshness remain unconfirmed.

item.description:
VIDEO | Delhi: High drama unfolded on Thursday at the send-off ceremony for the Indian contingent headed to the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Para Games, with several para-shooters staging a protest outside the venue and alleging corruption and manipulation in the selection process.

Among those leading the protest were para-shooters Sandeep Kumar and Akash, who questioned their exclusion from the contingent despite their rankings and performances.

Sandeep is ranked third in Asia, while Akash is the top-ranked shooter in the continent. They also questioned the inclusion of Rudransh Khandelwal, who they said is ranked 14th in Asia.

Akash alleged that his credentials were overlooked because he had not mentioned shooting coach Jai Prakash Nautiyal as his coach.

"That is why he cut my name. I have been here for two months. He keeps saying that we are doing your work. Every day, he says that we are doing your work, but he is not doing anything," Akash alleged.

Sandeep, a P4 50m free pistol SH1 shooter, said he did not receive any assurance from Jhajharia despite showing documents supporting his case.

(Full video available on PTI Videos - http://ptivideos.com)

item.title: 🇯🇵 JAPAN: 110M NTT DOCOMO "d POINT" LOYALTY RECORDS ALLEGEDLY UP FOR SALE A threat actor on an underground forum is advertising what they descri...
item.description:
🇯🇵 JAPAN: 110M NTT DOCOMO "d POINT" LOYALTY RECORDS ALLEGEDLY UP FOR SALE

A threat actor on an underground forum is advertising what they describe as 110 million customer records from d POINT, NTT DOCOMO's loyalty rewards program in Japan.

The listing claims:
* 110M customer loyalty records
* Member ID, d POINT card number, name, email, phone, street address, prefecture, postal code, date of birth and age
* DOCOMO line and mobile plan details, d CARD type and annual fee, d Payment status, member rank and monthly spend
* Points earned, redeemed, balances and expiry dates, plus last activity date
* A block of "sample lines" (removed from our image)

The claim has not been independently verified.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
The column list is detailed and fits a loyalty program, but headers and a few sample rows are easy to fabricate, and 110 million records would cover nearly the whole program, which makes a complete genuine dump less likely than a partial or recycled set. No proof of access is shown in the capture. If real, names, addresses, birth dates and phone numbers tied to card numbers and mobile plans would fuel convincing DOCOMO- and points-themed phishing. This is an unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation that NTT DOCOMO or d POINT was breached.

#DDW #DarkWeb #Japan #NTTDocomo #dPOINT #DataBreach #ThreatIntelligence #CyberSecurity
